reconciliation.title: Invoice reconciliation
reconciliation.subtitle: Parts the distributor invoiced that still have no destination. Oldest first.
reconciliation.onlyUntriaged: Show only what nobody has triaged

explain.INSTALLED: The part sat in the warehouse and was eventually installed. It closes against that work order and leaves the tray.
explain.TECH: The glass broke in their hands. It stays assigned and visible here until the deduction lands in one of their payments — assigning is not charging.
explain.RETURNED: Goes back to the distributor. Stays visible until they issue the credit note, which is the proof the money came back.
explain.LOSS: The business absorbs it. Recorded with a date and who decided.

reconciliation.explainNone: Pick an outcome. Each one has to leave a real trace: a work order, a deduction in a payment, a credit note, or an absorbed loss.
reconciliation.footnote: Triaging does not close a row. It leaves the tray when the cost lands somewhere — which is why 39 parts worth $5,537.77 sat assigned to a technician for years without anyone charging them.
